author: feenberg
body:
I would go along with PE on this if you feel that is the better choice.  I
don't suppose we know anyone in Nebraska who would know which makes more
sense.

On Sun, Feb 15, 2026 at 7:08 PM Pavel Makarchuk ***@***.***>
wrote:

> *PavelMakarchuk* left a comment (PolicyEngine/policyengine-taxsim#676)
> <https://github.com/PolicyEngine/policyengine-taxsim/issues/676#issuecomment-3905640919>
>
> The $4,000 gap is from the NE Refundable CTC (Child Care Tax Credit Act,
> §77-7203). PE gives $2,000 × 2 eligible children (ages 2 and 4, ≤ 5). It
> seems like TaxAct gives $0 because the credit requires Form 7203
> certification — the child must be enrolled in licensed child care and the
> parent must obtain a certificate from NE DOR. TaxAct leaves line 46 blank.
>
> We currently dont account for this condition in PE
